text:
```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  kani:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: nightly
          components: rust-src

      - name: Install Kani
        run: cargo install kani

      - name: Run Kani verification
        run: |
          cd storage
          cargo kani test --features kani
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: "-Zmir-opt-level=3"
```
